soilTypes.title: Types of Analyses Performed on Soil Samples
text: Chemical Analysis: Includes the analysis of organic pollutants (BTEX, PAH, TPH), heavy elements, toxic metals, pH levels, organic matter, nutrients, and dissolved salts.
Physical Analysis:Includes the determination of moisture content, bulk and true density, and the percentages of sand, silt, and clay
Biological Analysis: Conducted to examine and assess microorganisms

airQuality.title: Air quality Monitoring
airQuality.subTitle: Purpose of air quality Monitoring
airQuality.description: Air quality monitoring is the process of measuring and analyzing pollutants in the air to understand how clean or polluted the air is. It helps protect human health, the environment, and supports environmental management.
list: Assess Environmental Health Identify the levels of air pollutants and evaluate their impact on human health, ecosystems, and overall environmental quality.
Ensure Regulatory Compliance Verify compliance with local and international environmental standards and regulations set by authorities.
Identify Pollution Sources Determine the origin and contribution of pollution sources (industrial, traffic, construction, etc.) to support control strategies.
Support Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) Provide accurate data for baseline studies and for evaluating the impact of existing or proposed projects.
Guide Mitigation and Control Measures Help design effective pollution control and air quality improvement plans.
Monitor Trends and Changes Over Time Track variations in air quality to assess the effectiveness of environmental policies and corrective actions.
